title: Crypto Payment Gateways Dataset (v1.5.0, 95 gateways)
description:
An open, hand-verified dataset of 95 crypto payment gateways classified by custody model, platform fee, KYC requirement, coin coverage, fiat settlement and Lightning support, every fee linked to the official pricing page or docs it was read from. Updated monthly. Headline finding: 64% of gateways are custodial and 24% non-custodial (study cohort, n=50); the living dataset (n=95) holds at 64% custodial, 25% non-custodial.

Methodology: Classification of crypto payment gateways by published custody model, per-transaction fee, KYC requirement, coin coverage, fiat settlement and Lightning support, from provider pricing pages and docs as of August 2026. The published study (study_cohort=true) covers 50 gateways; this is a living dataset that also lists additional verified gateways (study_cohort=false). Rows with verified=false could not have their fee confirmed on an official page. Custody is an editorial classification based on each provider docs.

Write-up and live JSON/CSV: https://shieldz.cash/blog/custody-gap-crypto-payment-gateways
